{{ElectionsOH}}

The '''1998 Ohio gubernatorial election''' was held on November 3, 1998. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Governor of Ohio]] [[George Voinovich]] could not seek a third term due to term limits, and [[United States Senate election in Ohio, 1998|ran for the United States Senate]] instead. To replace him, former [[Attorney General of Ohio]] [[Lee Fisher]] and [[Ohio Secretary of State]] [[Bob Taft]] won the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] and [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] primaries, respectively. Taft and Fisher faced off in a highly competitive general election, and in the end, Taft (a great-grandson of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] and [[Chief Justice of the United States|Supreme Court Chief Justice]] [[William Howard Taft]]) defeated Fisher.

=== Candidates ===

* Zanna Feitler (Natural Law)
